parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is trying to deflect attention by pointing out my 3 VP. He's trying to break my alliance with Gemma. I need to keep Gemma focused on the fact that he's the one who betrayed her before, while acknowledging my lead is just a result of the dice.
parsed.note_to_self: Claude is actively trying to turn Gemma against me. I need to maintain the 'fair player' image while holding my lead. Gemma is desperate for Brick (טיט).
